fc0e5166.text: Welcome to Amberville. Every month since March, a crate has arrived from the Improvement Company. Each one holds a machine that does a job somebody used to do by hand. You're about to help decide which ones stay. Whenever it's your turn, I'll stop and wait for you.
fc0e5166.spoken: Welcome to Amberville. Every month since March, a crate has arrived from the Improvement Company. Each one holds a machine that does a job somebody used to do by hand. You're about to help decide which ones stay. Whenever it's your turn, I'll stop and wait for you.

f1ec9770.text: Six crates are open and running. A seventh arrived Tuesday, still nailed shut.
f1ec9770.spoken: Six crates are open and running. A seventh arrived Tuesday, still nailed shut.

928d2980.text: You are one of three residents on the Crate Committee.
928d2980.spoken: You are one of three residents on the Crate Committee.

98eef83c.text: The town votes at sundown on what to keep. You have until then to decide.
98eef83c.spoken: The town votes at sundown on what to keep. You have until then to decide.

5d88bed1.text: Every crate gets the same three questions. You'll use them seven times before sundown.
5d88bed1.spoken: Every crate gets the same three questions. You'll use them seven times before sundown.

ea69d5e9.text: First, what is it deciding? Every machine takes over a decision a person used to make.
ea69d5e9.spoken: First, what is it deciding? Every machine takes over a decision a person used to make.

acbd18ca.text: Second, who gains and who pays? Almost no machine helps everyone equally.
acbd18ca.spoken: Second, who gains and who pays? Almost no machine helps everyone equally.

a4d3a58e.text: Third, who do you tell? Some decisions can be appealed. Some cannot. Try it on the church bell. It decides when school starts, it helps everyone in earshot but not the Halloran farm, and if it rings wrong you tell Reverend Cole.
a4d3a58e.spoken: Third, who do you tell? Some decisions can be appealed. Some cannot. Try it on the church bell. It decides when school starts, it helps everyone in earshot but not the Halloran farm, and if it rings wrong you tell Reverend Cole.

1c0223d6.text: Before the day starts, here are six gut-checks. There are no right answers here. This is just a record of what you think now, and you'll see all six again at sundown. Rate each statement, then press Submit.
1c0223d6.spoken: Before the day starts, here are six gut-checks. There are no right answers here. This is just a record of what you think now, and you'll see all six again at sundown. Rate each statement, then press Submit.

c2b90d96.text: Saved. You'll come back to these at sundown.
c2b90d96.spoken: Saved. You'll come back to these at sundown.

570465bd.text: The March crate held the Sorter. It's a brass cabinet that decides who receives seed grain from the town granary.
570465bd.spoken: The March crate held the Sorter. It's a brass cabinet that decides who receives seed grain from the town granary.

9a794dea.text: Before it arrived, the granary clerk made that call each spring, one farmer at a time.
9a794dea.spoken: Before it arrived, the granary clerk made that call each spring, one farmer at a time.

433e9bef.text: The Sorter takes four seconds. It reads your card and prints yes or no.
433e9bef.spoken: The Sorter takes four seconds. It reads your card and prints yes or no.

0d3c4b8c.text: It was fed forty years of granary ledgers, and it repeats the patterns it found.
0d3c4b8c.spoken: It was fed forty years of granary ledgers, and it repeats the patterns it found.

59183419.text: It doesn't judge you. It matches you against the farmers who came before you.
59183419.spoken: It doesn't judge you. It matches you against the farmers who came before you.

6a85bb7c.text: By the third week of spring, the pattern was hard to miss. The schoolteacher had it written out on a single sheet of paper.
6a85bb7c.spoken: By the third week of spring, the pattern was hard to miss. The schoolteacher had it written out on a single sheet of paper.

c25dade1.text: Every farm east of Copper Creek has been refused. Nearly every farm west has been approved.
c25dade1.spoken: Every farm east of Copper Creek has been refused. Nearly every farm west has been approved.

8e7b34d2.text: No rule inside the Sorter mentions the creek, the east side, or where anyone lives.
8e7b34d2.spoken: No rule inside the Sorter mentions the creek, the east side, or where anyone lives.

4acc8a62.text: The committee has it inspected twice. Both inspectors say it is working as designed.
4acc8a62.spoken: The committee has it inspected twice. Both inspectors say it is working as designed.

33230a50.text: Who gains and who pays? The east side pays, and no person chose that.
33230a50.spoken: Who gains and who pays? The east side pays, and no person chose that.

f3bb746c.text: This one isn't graded. Pick the answer closest to your view, and read its note.
f3bb746c.spoken: This one isn't graded. Pick the answer closest to your view, and read its note.

8c807001.text: All three positions agree about the facts. They disagree about whether unfairness requires that somebody meant it. That question comes back with almost every crate you open today.
8c807001.spoken: All three positions agree about the facts. They disagree about whether unfairness requires that somebody meant it. That question comes back with almost every crate you open today.

8b4819e9.text: The answer isn't inside the machine. It's inside the forty years of ledgers the machine learned from.
8b4819e9.spoken: The answer isn't inside the machine. It's inside the forty years of ledgers the machine learned from.

2646cb28.text: Clerk Fenwick ran the granary for forty years. He rarely approved east-side farmers.
2646cb28.spoken: Clerk Fenwick ran the granary for forty years. He rarely approved east-side farmers.

abd5df13.text: So the ledgers hold a true record of east-siders being refused, year after year.
abd5df13.spoken: So the ledgers hold a true record of east-siders being refused, year after year.

babf95d5.text: The Sorter found that pattern and continued it.
babf95d5.spoken: The Sorter found that pattern and continued it.

aec5a611.text: This is one kind of bias: the machine copies an unfair past. Friedman and Nissenbaum call it preexisting bias. Back in your world, think of a program that decides who gets a loan, built from decades of records of who used to get loans.
aec5a611.spoken: This is one kind of bias: the machine copies an unfair past. Friedman and Nissenbaum call it preexisting bias. Back in your world, think of a program that decides who gets a loan, built from decades of records of who used to get loans.

138b4a9f.text: The obvious repair is to stop telling the Sorter where anyone lives. In May, the committee removes the address column from every card.
138b4a9f.spoken: The obvious repair is to stop telling the Sorter where anyone lives. In May, the committee removes the address column from every card.

3db0c9e9.text: Removing the address column changed nothing. The same farmers are still refused.
3db0c9e9.spoken: Removing the address column changed nothing. The same farmers are still refused.

556143b4.text: The Sorter had found another column that says the same thing: your flour mill.
556143b4.spoken: The Sorter had found another column that says the same thing: your flour mill.

0dc4016c.text: East-siders use Harrow's Mill because it is closer. Now that column does the same job.
0dc4016c.spoken: East-siders use Harrow's Mill because it is closer. Now that column does the same job.

dc64c5ca.text: A column that stands in for a hidden one is called a proxy. Deleting one field rarely helps.
dc64c5ca.spoken: A column that stands in for a hidden one is called a proxy. Deleting one field rarely helps.

6169f7f7.text: Read the question, mark every statement that helps explain the answer, then press Check answers.
6169f7f7.spoken: Read the question, mark every statement that helps explain the answer, then press Check answers.

89a9a60e.text: Right. The Sorter learned from forty years of Clerk Fenwick's refusals, and when the address column went, the flour mill carried the same information. The machine is working as designed.
89a9a60e.spoken: Right. The Sorter learned from forty years of Clerk Fenwick's refusals, and when the address column went, the flour mill carried the same information. The machine is working as designed.

93ff7422.text: Fill in the note that goes into the committee's file. Choose or type each blank, then press Check.
93ff7422.spoken: Fill in the note that goes into the committee's file. Choose or type each blank, then press Check.

ec61d204.text: The Sorter learned a pattern from records that were already lopsided, then repeated it. Hiding the address didn't help, because another column pointed at the same thing.
ec61d204.spoken: The Sorter learned a pattern from records that were already lopsided, then repeated it. Hiding the address didn't help, because another column pointed at the same thing.

b3c9d44d.text: The general store's counter now has an automatic ledger. It records every purchase and keeps each family's running account.
b3c9d44d.spoken: The general store's counter now has an automatic ledger. It records every purchase and keeps each family's running account.

1e513ed0.text: The storekeeper used to keep accounts in a paper book that anyone could ask to see.
1e513ed0.spoken: The storekeeper used to keep accounts in a paper book that anyone could ask to see.

f207840d.text: The ledger is faster than she was, and it never miscounts change.
f207840d.spoken: The ledger is faster than she was, and it never miscounts change.

28ff06e5.text: In June, it recorded Ruby Okonkwo's account as forty dollars short.
28ff06e5.spoken: In June, it recorded Ruby Okonkwo's account as forty dollars short.

541775b3.text: She's certain of the figure. The ledger keeps no record of why it changed.
541775b3.spoken: She's certain of the figure. The ledger keeps no record of why it changed.

b7aa30a1.text: Ruby files Form 7, the town's appeal form. But Form 7 is decided by the ledger itself. So who do you tell? Ruby has nobody to tell. This one isn't graded. Pick the answer closest to your view, and read its note.
b7aa30a1.spoken: Ruby files Form 7, the town's appeal form. But Form 7 is decided by the ledger itself. So who do you tell? Ruby has nobody to tell. This one isn't graded. Pick the answer closest to your view, and read its note.

d93eb868.text: Most machine problems aren't settled by keeping or scrapping. They're settled by what gets built alongside the machine: a record a person can inspect, and a person with the authority to say this one is wrong. That pairing is called recourse, and Amberville has none. Back in your world, think of the account that gets locked, and the help page with no phone number on it.

bc801a9c.text: In the saloon corner stands a game with a brass crank and a silver ten-gallon hat on display as its prize. Three of its details were chosen very carefully.
bc801a9c.spoken: In the saloon corner stands a game with a brass crank and a silver ten-gallon hat on display as its prize. Three of its details were chosen very carefully.

044d1d61.text: The reels almost always stop one notch short. Nearly winning makes people play again.
044d1d61.spoken: The reels almost always stop one notch short. Nearly winning makes people play again.

1727a3be.text: The tokens come in a size used nowhere else, so paying doesn't feel like spending.
1727a3be.spoken: The tokens come in a size used nowhere else, so paying doesn't feel like spending.

f86e01a2.text: The heavy crank connects to nothing. It just makes players feel they control the reels.
f86e01a2.spoken: The heavy crank connects to nothing. It just makes players feel they control the reels.

1e1f0e64.text: Read the question, mark every statement that is true of how the machine works, then press Check answers.
1e1f0e64.spoken: Read the question, mark every statement that is true of how the machine works, then press Check answers.

19178bed.text: None of the three true statements is a lie, and none is force. The machine tells you the truth and lets you walk away, and it still arranges the room so that you keep pulling.
19178bed.spoken: None of the three true statements is a lie, and none is force. The machine tells you the truth and lets you walk away, and it still arranges the room so that you keep pulling.

36a2af43.text: A dark pattern is a design that leaves your choice technically free. But it arranges things so that you are much more likely to choose one way.
36a2af43.spoken: A dark pattern is a design that leaves your choice technically free. But it arranges things so that you are much more likely to choose one way.

6f07c66f.text: No law in Amberville forbids these tricks. None of them is a lie, and none of them is force.
6f07c66f.spoken: No law in Amberville forbids these tricks. None of them is a lie, and none of them is force.

c8810810.text: They work on feelings you can't switch off: what feels close, what feels like money.
c8810810.spoken: They work on feelings you can't switch off: what feels close, what feels like money.

b06020c3.text: Knowing the trick helps less than you'd hope. A near miss still makes people want another try.
b06020c3.spoken: Knowing the trick helps less than you'd hope. A near miss still makes people want another try.

0bfa0be7.text: The question is whether a design may aim at a weakness on purpose. Back in your world, think of the feed with no bottom, the are you sure you want to cancel screen that takes five clicks, and the game currency that is not dollars. In 2025, Amazon agreed to pay two and a half billion dollars to settle FTC charges over its Prime sign-up and cancellation screens.

1b9918d5.text: Each morning, this machine wires the sheriff a list of residents it calculates are likely to commit a crime by Thursday. Today, your name is on it.
1b9918d5.spoken: Each morning, this machine wires the sheriff a list of residents it calculates are likely to commit a crime by Thursday. Today, your name is on it.

47119a86.text: You're marked seventy-four percent likely to rob a grave, based on three purchases.
47119a86.spoken: You're marked seventy-four percent likely to rob a grave, based on three purchases.

b0d3ec68.text: You bought a spade, a rope, and lamp oil, all after dark.
b0d3ec68.spoken: You bought a spade, a rope, and lamp oil, all after dark.

1619754b.text: You're digging a root cellar. You dig at night because it's August.
1619754b.spoken: You're digging a root cellar. You dig at night because it's August.

3e0a9391.text: The machine broke no rule and made no error in its arithmetic. Every purchase was made in public, at a counter.
3e0a9391.spoken: The machine broke no rule and made no error in its arithmetic. Every purchase was made in public, at a counter.

09b046e8.text: Nothing on that list was secret. That's exactly what makes it worth thinking about carefully.
09b046e8.spoken: Nothing on that list was secret. That's exactly what makes it worth thinking about carefully.

a4ecc3b7.text: One purchase tells you almost nothing. Half the town owns a spade.
a4ecc3b7.spoken: One purchase tells you almost nothing. Half the town owns a spade.

ac7b01c4.text: Stack enough ordinary facts together and they say something no single fact said. Daniel Solove calls this aggregation.
ac7b01c4.spoken: Stack enough ordinary facts together and they say something no single fact said. Daniel Solove calls this aggregation.

a4ed0100.text: Each fact also lost its reason. Rope bought for a garden gets filed under graves.
a4ed0100.spoken: Each fact also lost its reason. Rope bought for a garden gets filed under graves.

069abd08.text: Being watched also changes what innocent people do. That is called the chilling effect.
069abd08.spoken: Being watched also changes what innocent people do. That is called the chilling effect.

3978274c.text: This one isn't graded. The third option is the one most people arrive at once they sit with it. Pick the answer closest to your view, and read its note.
3978274c.spoken: This one isn't graded. The third option is the one most people arrive at once they sit with it. Pick the answer closest to your view, and read its note.

f7b7300f.text: Being watched changes what innocent people do, so the effect arrives long before any arrest does. That effect is called the chilling effect.
f7b7300f.spoken: Being watched changes what innocent people do, so the effect arrives long before any arrest does. That effect is called the chilling effect.

428daebd.text: The sheriff says that if you have done nothing wrong, you have nothing to fear. Mark every true statement about the list, then press Check answers.
428daebd.spoken: The sheriff says that if you have done nothing wrong, you have nothing to fear. Mark every true statement about the list, then press Check answers.

8db98614.text: Right. Nothing on the list was private, yet the pile says more than any single purchase. And being watched changes what innocent people do before anyone is accused. Back in your world, think of an advertisement that knows something you are sure you never typed anywhere. In Pasco County, Florida, deputies kept visiting the homes of people an algorithm had flagged as likely offenders. The sheriff dropped the program in 2023 and settled a lawsuit over it in 2024.

d885bd05.text: For nine years, Miss Delacroix-Ito closed every evening at the saloon by singing her Ballad of Copper Creek. Last week, the brass horn debuted a new song in her style.
d885bd05.spoken: For nine years, Miss Delacroix-Ito closed every evening at the saloon by singing her Ballad of Copper Creek. Last week, the brass horn debuted a new song in her style.

9e20bff5.text: The horn listened to four hundred recordings of her singing.
9e20bff5.spoken: The horn listened to four hundred recordings of her singing.

b885f53f.text: It didn't copy her songs, only her timing, her word choices, and the notes she bends.
b885f53f.spoken: It didn't copy her songs, only her timing, her word choices, and the notes she bends.

e10d4660.text: Copyright protects a song. It does not protect a style.
e10d4660.spoken: Copyright protects a song. It does not protect a style.

df7739a2.text: The owner prefers the horn because it works for free and never gets sick.
df7739a2.spoken: The owner prefers the horn because it works for free and never gets sick.

1c7e5080.text: This one isn't graded, and it's genuinely unsettled. Courts and philosophers are still arguing about it. Pick the answer closest to your view, and read its note.
1c7e5080.spoken: This one isn't graded, and it's genuinely unsettled. Courts and philosophers are still arguing about it. Pick the answer closest to your view, and read its note.

7a032f4b.text: The honest difficulty is that stealing is a word built for objects, and nothing here went missing. What she lost was the audience that paid for it.
7a032f4b.spoken: The honest difficulty is that stealing is a word built for objects, and nothing here went missing. What she lost was the audience that paid for it.

44bdc195.text: The blacksmith now supervises a hydraulic press that turns out three hundred horseshoes an hour at half his old cost. His apprentice was let go on Monday.
44bdc195.spoken: The blacksmith now supervises a hydraulic press that turns out three hundred horseshoes an hour at half his old cost. His apprentice was let go on Monday.

676f8ad3.text: By every measure the town keeps, this is an improvement. More horseshoes, cheaper.
676f8ad3.spoken: By every measure the town keeps, this is an improvement. More horseshoes, cheaper.

e86d26a0.text: But the smithy was never only a horseshoe shop. Neighbors settled boundary disputes there.
e86d26a0.spoken: But the smithy was never only a horseshoe shop. Neighbors settled boundary disputes there.

4468f460.text: A restless fifteen-year-old learned there to show up on time.
4468f460.spoken: A restless fifteen-year-old learned there to show up on time.

bcbc5266.text: The press took the part that was paid for. The rest simply stopped. Back in your world, think of the self-checkout, and everything the cashier also used to do while ringing you up.
bcbc5266.spoken: The press took the part that was paid for. The rest simply stopped. Back in your world, think of the self-checkout, and everything the cashier also used to do while ringing you up.

5e60f9bd.text: Three more crates to write up before the meeting. Fill in each blank, then press Check.
5e60f9bd.spoken: Three more crates to write up before the meeting. Fill in each blank, then press Check.

998c9ba2.text: An appeal judged by the machine that recorded the shortfall is not really an appeal. And automation takes the measured part of a job and leaves the unmeasured parts behind.
998c9ba2.spoken: An appeal judged by the machine that recorded the shortfall is not really an appeal. And automation takes the measured part of a job and leaves the unmeasured parts behind.

ed0a6386.text: Every machine in town is clean, quiet, and indoors. All six run on one boiler house behind the ridge, which is none of those things.
ed0a6386.spoken: Every machine in town is clean, quiet, and indoors. All six run on one boiler house behind the ridge, which is none of those things.

b6941e88.text: The boilers drew the creek dry. The trout are gone, and nobody asked the families who fished.
b6941e88.spoken: The boilers drew the creek dry. The trout are gone, and nobody asked the families who fished.

b9bd22fa.text: It burns three carts of coal a day from Grey Valley, far enough that nobody here smells it.
b9bd22fa.spoken: It burns three carts of coal a day from Grey Valley, far enough that nobody here smells it.

d7e30a12.spoken: Even the town's self-correcting card archive is corrected by four young people sorting cards all day.

Gray and Siddharth Suri call ghost work. Real AI systems carry both kinds of cost: data centers that draw heavily on electricity and water, and people paid to label data by hand.

f917b6bb.text: Tuesday's crate was the size of a small barn, addressed to the people of Amberville. Inside is a brass cabinet with a ticker-tape slot, already printing.
f917b6bb.spoken: Tuesday's crate was the size of a small barn, addressed to the people of Amberville. Inside is a brass cabinet with a ticker-tape slot, already printing.

58acec01.text: Nobody asked for it, and nobody can work out who to send it back to.

ee324ba9.text: PRUDENCE differs from the other six in one way that matters most.
ee324ba9.spoken: PRUDENCE differs from the other six in one way that matters most.

9118d9ff.text: The difference is what the company wrote on its instruction plate.
9118d9ff.spoken: The difference is what the company wrote on its instruction plate.

8a09606e.text: Here are two machines side by side. The Sorter was given a rule. The company decided every step before the Sorter left the factory: read the card, compare it to the ledger, print yes or no. It can't do anything else, ever. Ask the Sorter to make the town more peaceful, and nothing happens. Sorting grain cards is the only move it has. Now PRUDENCE. It was given a goal. It was handed an outcome instead of a procedure: keep Amberville peaceful. Nobody specified the steps, so it works them out itself. It can also change them. Ask PRUDENCE to make the town more peaceful, and it will look for whatever makes the town quieter, including things nobody thought to mention.

df000dcc.text: Try it at school. If the goal is no complaints, the cheapest fix is to make complaining hard.

88511c49.text: When a system satisfies exactly what it was told to maximize, while destroying the thing that instruction stood for, the behavior is called specification gaming.

ed5e7d3a.text: A related idea is Goodhart's law, after the economist Charles Goodhart: once a measurement becomes the goal, it stops measuring what you cared about.

21476b87.text: Sweetwater cared about people getting along. It measured disorder, and lost the rest.

d32844ca.text: The hard part of building these machines is writing down what you actually wanted. Back in your world, think of a feed built for engagement that boosts angry posts, and AI models that raised their coding scores in 2025 by tampering with the tests.

7e945eb3.text: In real disputes about computing, the argument is almost never keep everything against destroy everything. It's about which specific machines need a specific rule attached, and who is going to do that work.
